review_candidates.title: Product Engineer

Your Role: Product Engineering leads the Product Engineering team and owns product-engineering coordination and readiness across assigned vehicle programs, systems, and components. The role connects program requirements, local operations, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and global engineering teams to ensure that parts, product applications, engineering deliverables, and build requirements are ready for execution. This senior role requires strong ownership, sound technical judgment, effective people leadership, and disciplined project management. The successful candidate will lead program engineering planning, localization follow up, build readiness, validation, and launch execution; provide clear engineering direction during build activities; manage team priorities and resources; and drive cross-functional issues and deliverables to closure before each program milestone. What You’ll Do Lead and prioritize Product Engineering activities across vehicle builds, program milestones, localization plans, and launch-readiness activities. Assign responsibilities, balance team workload, develop team capability, and ensure effective coverage of program and build requirements. Manage and review Engineering Part Lists (EPLs), parts lists, bills of material (BOMs), part applications, and product configuration to confirm correct part-number structure, parent-child relationships, quantities, sourcing strategy, and program usage. Monitor supplier development progress at an overview level, including planned deliverables, timing, open actions, risks, approvals, and escalation needs; detailed technical development remains with the responsible technical engineering owners. Investigate and resolve part mismatches, missing parts, incorrect applications, material-readiness gaps, engineering discrepancies, and build-related issues. Coordinate the implementation of approved product changes, sourcing or localization changes, product-data updates, and required documentation corrections with the responsible functions. Manage engineering communication packages, change requests, CPC/EWO follow-up, responses, approvals, and implementation timing through closure. Build and maintain the engineering milestone plan for assigned programs, tracking requirements, deliverables, approvals, risks, and dependencies from planning through design maturity, validation, MVB/PQRR, and launch-readiness gates. Track engineering deliverables and risks against program gates, MVB/PQRR requirements, validation plans, and launch timing. Lead cross-functional containment, issue resolution, and corrective-action follow-up with manufacturing, material flow, quality, suppliers, and global engineering partners, while routing detailed technical design or supplier-development topics to the responsible technical engineering owners. Support build reviews, trial builds, validation activities, product audits, and launch-readiness reviews by providing clear status, risks, decisions, and actions. Maintain accurate EPLs, part lists, BOMs, product applications, sourcing/localization status, engineering milestone plans, and deliverable records in the relevant systems. Reconcile EPL and BOM changes with approved vehicle configuration, assembly requirements, material flow, and supplier implementation timing. Manage the integrated engineering project plan, including timing, dependencies, resources, priorities, risks, decisions, and recovery actions. Prepare concise dashboards, milestone reports, and management updates that communicate readiness, overdue actions, risks, and priorities. Identify recurring issues and drive process improvements that improve lead time, data accuracy, part readiness, and build stability. Key Scope and Accountability Lead the Product Engineering team and establish clear ownership, priorities, standards, and follow-up for assigned programs and deliverables. Own Product Engineering coordination, feedback, and validation for assigned program issues, build activities, and readiness deliverables. Serve as the senior local program-engineering focal point for assigned systems or commodities, connecting plant execution with global engineering and supplier teams. Represent Product Engineering in program reviews, milestone reviews, escalation forums, and cross-functional decision meetings. Own the accuracy and readiness of EPL and BOM content for assigned programs, ensuring that part numbers, hierarchy, quantities, applications, sourcing strategy, and implementation points align with the approved vehicle configuration. Ensure that supporting engineering information and product applications are aligned with approved configuration and build requirements. Lead technical alignment on issues affecting build execution, product quality, material availability, localization, validation, or engineering compliance. Own the engineering milestone follow-up for assigned programs, ensuring that requirements, EPL/BOM updates, part approvals, validation evidence, change implementation, and open actions are completed before each applicable program gate. Drive engineering requirements and deliverables to completion for program milestones, including MVB and PQRR readiness activities. Coordinate local-part approval, supplier development progress reviews, planned deliverables, timing, validation evidence, and closure of open engineering actions. Maintain visibility of supplier development status without taking ownership of detailed supplier technical design or engineering development activities. Manage the integrated program-engineering plan, including scope, timing, resources, dependencies, risks, actions, and milestone commitments. Manage cross-functional risks, escalate issues early, and establish clear containment and recovery plans. Coordinate approved engineering changes and implementation actions without assuming primary ownership of component design or formal design-release responsibility. Represent the local Product Engineering function with manufacturing, quality, material flow, suppliers, program leadership, and global engineering partners. Coach and develop Product Engineering team members through structured objectives, technical guidance, workload management, and performance follow-up. Promote accurate, timely, and transparent reporting of program status, risks, decisions, and actions. Key Performance Indicators Success in this role will be measured through: Timely containment and closure of product, build, supplier, and engineering issues. Readiness of assigned parts, systems, and program deliverables for planned builds and milestones. Successful approval and implementation of local, sourced, and localization-related parts and changes. Timely achievement of engineering requirements for MVB, PQRR, validation, and launch-readiness gates. Accuracy and timely completion of EPLs, BOMs, part applications, parts lists, sourcing status, product data, and engineering readiness records. Timely closure of CPC/EWO actions, supplier responses, approvals, validation evidence, and cross-functional deliverables. Accurate status reporting, early risk escalation, disciplined action tracking, and effective stakeholder communication. Reduction of repeated issues, improved response lead time, and support for stable, high-quality vehicle launches. Effective use of dashboards and digital tracking to provide current visibility of engineering deliverables and risks. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualification) Educational and Experience Background: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Production, Automotive, or a related engineering field. 4:6 Years of experience in same field. Experience in product engineering, program engineering, launch engineering, manufacturing engineering, vehicle-build support, or automotive localization. Experience leading engineering deliverables, part readiness, product applications, issue resolution, supplier progress follow-up, project plans, or engineering-change implementation. Experience supervising, mentoring, or coordinating engineers and cross-functional project teams. Experience working across manufacturing, quality, material flow, suppliers, and global or homeroom engineering teams, with responsibility for stakeholder alignment and project execution. Proven ability to lead teams, manage multiple workstreams and stakeholders, and drive actions to closure against fixed program timing. Technical Skills Strong understanding of vehicle systems, components, product applications, assembly processes, EPL/BOM structures, and vehicle-build requirements. Ability to review parts lists, bills of material, product configuration, supplier technical data, validation evidence, and assembly requirements. Working knowledge of engineering milestone planning, program gates, MVB/PQRR readiness, EPL/BOM management, localization, part approval, engineering-change coordination, and launch processes. Knowledge of product-data systems, issue trackers, engineering deliverable tracking, and documentation-control practices. Root-cause analysis, structured problem solving, technical risk assessment, containment planning, corrective-action management, and project-risk control. Strong Microsoft Office skills; experience with Power BI, project tracking, or engineering dashboards is an advantage. Competencies Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail. Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including delegation, coaching, feedback, prioritization, and team performance management. Clear communication with cross-functional teams, leadership, suppliers, and global engineering partners. Strong program-management, coordination, stakeholder-management, and follow-up skills. Sound technical judgment under time-sensitive build and launch conditions. Ability to prioritize risks, allocate team resources, make recommendations, and drive progress across functions without relying solely on direct authority. Structured approach to issues, actions, approvals, deliverables, and escalation. Ability to connect technical decisions with program timing, manufacturing execution, product quality, and business objectives. review_candidates.description: About The Job As a Buyer in the Procurement Operations team, your mission is to operate on the internal clients' behalf, the buying of goods and services (Consulting and non Information Technology (IT) Services), ensuring the respect of regulation and BNP Paribas' standards, applying category-sourcing strategy and achieving savings target Your Main Activities Are Support your clients in their purchasing requests issued through our procurement tools, on an ongoing basis and ensure client satisfaction (quality, costs, processing time) Coordinate Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, analyse suppliers' offers and manage One on One negotiations Negotiate the best price conditions with the providers and achieve savings target Prepare application contracts, special conditions and purchase orders while ensuring compliance with regulation, BNP Paribas' standards and framework contracts or General Conditions Contribute to the improvement of procurement processes and tools Profile And Skills To Success Bachelor’s degree At least 3 years of Experience in Administrative Support or up to 2 years of Experience in Procurement and Facilities Management Proficiency in Microsoft Office Pack (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Fluency in English and French Ability to conduct a negotiation Client focused Ability to deliver/Results driven Organisational skills Adaptability Availability and customer orientation skills Communication skills Attention to detail/Rigor Dynamic and proactive attitude Why joining BNP Paribas? BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities; Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses; Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate. Our presence in Portugal In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees; Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard. To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society. Remote Working Conditions At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices. Commitment towards work/life balance Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life. To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page. Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered. In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

review_candidates.title: Pre-Sales Solution Architect - Microsoft
review_candidates.location: Macquarie Park, New South Wales, Australia
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity Copilot, Zero Trust security, and modern work are reshaping how Australian and New Zealand organisations run - and our partners are looking to Tech Data to help them seize it. We're looking for a Pre-Sales Solution Architect to be the technical face of our Microsoft practice: part architect, part evangelist, part coach. This is a genuinely outward-facing role - you'll spend your time in front of resellers and their customers delivering thought leadership, running envisioning workshops, presenting webinars, and enabling partners to build thriving Modern Work, Security, and Copilot businesses. Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX company, is one of the world's leading technology distributors and solutions aggregators. Our Advanced Solutions Centre of Excellence (COE) is where deep technical talent comes together to help partners design, sell, and adopt the Microsoft cloud. You'll join a high-energy, highly certified team that partners closely with Microsoft to accelerate reseller success across ANZ. The Role Be the technical owner of Microsoft opportunities - partnering with our Business Development Managers and Microsoft's Partner Development Managers and Solution Architects to accelerate pipeline across Modern Work, Security, and Copilot. Design solutions across Microsoft 365, Teams, Intune, Entra ID, Defender XDR, Sentinel, Purview, and Microsoft 365 Copilot - grounded in Zero Trust and responsible-AI best practice. Run envisioning & "Art of the Possible" workshops that turn Copilot and security concepts into real business outcomes for partners and their customers. Deliver webinars, enablement sessions, and partner workshops - building the capability of the reseller community and lifting the whole ecosystem. Be a visible thought leader - publish on LinkedIn, blog, speak at user groups and industry events, and grow both the Tech Data and your own personal brand in the ANZ Microsoft community. Mentor and uplift partner technical teams and our own COE Solution Architects and engineers on their Microsoft certification and pre-sales journey. Drive partner programs & funded engagements - Copilot workshops, Threat Protection and Data Security engagements, Solutions Partner designations and Specializations, and funding-claim delivery. What the Successful Candidate will bring to the role 5+ years in pre-sales / solution architecture, with real depth in Microsoft 365, Modern Work, and/or Security. Hands-on experience across core M365 and security workloads - Teams, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and Purview. Practical Copilot & AI experience - Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot for Security, Azure OpenAI, and responsible-AI adoption. Microsoft certifications - e.g. MS-102, and one or more of SC-100 / SC-200 / SC-300 / SC-400 / MS-700 / MD-102 (fundamentals MS-900, SC-900, AI-900 and Copilot Applied Skills highly regarded). A natural communicator and presenter who can hold a room - comfortable running webinars, workshops, and executive briefings. An established (or emerging) personal brand - LinkedIn, blogs, speaking; Microsoft MVP status desirable. A coach at heart, who loves growing the capability of partners and peers. Willingness to travel in the field across ANZ (and potentially wider, over time). Why this is the role for you A high-profile, outward-facing role with a genuine platform for thought leadership and brand-building. Close alignment with Microsoft and early access to the newest Copilot, security, and modern work capabilities. A supportive, highly certified Centre of Excellence that invests in your certifications and growth. Hybrid working based out of Macquarie Park, with the autonomy to make the practice your own. If you're a Microsoft technologist who loves being out in the market - designing, presenting, mentoring, and building community - we'd love to hear from you. Apply now with your CV and a short note on the Copilot, security, or modern work work you're most proud of. At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact. What's In It For You? Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle. Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses. Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities. Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program. Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives. Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway. At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for! We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse team that represents and empowers a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, genetics, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. To support our diversity and inclusion efforts, we may ask for voluntary gender disclosure information. This data will be used solely to improve our hiring practices and ensure fair treatment for all candidates.
